home.title: My newsroom
home.lead: Your media, articles and team invitations.
home.empty: No accessible media in this list. Create a media activity or accept an invitation.

desk.title: Newsroom
desk.lead: Preparing, reviewing and publishing remain separate actions.
desk.filteredWindow: No accessible items here. You can continue.
desk.newArticleHint: The first save creates a private draft.
desk.unconfigured: Configure the media before preparing its articles.
desk.uncertainCreate: Creation is not confirmed yet. Keep this input: Try again repeats exactly the same creation. If the draft was saved, it remains available in the newsroom.

config.title: Configure the media
config.lead: The social page remains separate from the editorial site.
config.sectionKeyHint: A short, stable identifier: news, economy, culture…
config.sectionHint: Up to 12 sections. Changing a section does not silently move its articles.
config.publicConsent: I agree to distribute this media’s published articles on its public ANTSIA site.
config.required: This media has not been configured yet.

article.title: Prepare an article
article.lead: An article is an editorial version, separate from a social post.
article.headline: Headline
article.correctionHint: Explain the correction to the published version without erasing its history. A notice is required for the new publication.
article.bodyHint: Up to 40 blocks, 4 images and 32 KiB of text. No HTML or scripts.
article.previewHint: This working preview publishes nothing. Images remain subject to file checks.
article.correctionKept: The published version remains readable while this correction is prepared.
article.saved: Draft saved. No publication was started.
article.readOnly: You can read this article; your permission does not allow editing.

blocks.heading: Section heading
blocks.linkHint: A complete HTTPS address, without scripts or embedded content.

images.title: Image library
images.lead: Use admitted newsroom images or upload an image with credits and publication rights.
images.fileHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MiB.
images.altHint: Describe what the image contributes to the article, in up to 300 characters.
images.creditHint: Photographer or authorised source, in up to 200 characters.
images.consent: I have the rights needed to publish this image and its credit.
images.add: Add this image to the article
images.uploaded: Image uploaded. Display awaits file checks.
images.withheld: This image is not available for display.
images.invalid: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 8 MiB.
images.limit: An article can contain up to 4 images.

workflow.title: Review and publication
workflow.lead: Actions apply to the saved version shown. Save your changes and review it before continuing.
workflow.scheduleHint: Choose a time in this device’s time zone. The corresponding UTC instant is shown before confirmation.
workflow.submitConfirm: Send this saved version for review?
workflow.approveConfirm: Approve this saved version for publication?
workflow.requestChangesConfirm: Request these changes to this version?
workflow.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw the published version of this article?
workflow.changed: Editorial action saved. Review the current state before continuing.
workflow.missingCorrection: A correction notice is required before publishing a new version.

team.title: Newsroom team
team.lead: Editorial permissions grant no commercial powers or personal access.
team.invited: Invitation saved; permissions await the recipient’s acceptance.
team.bylineConsent: I agree to allow my public name as an article byline for this media.
team.bylineHint: This agreement is separate from accepting your permission. It is never preselected.
team.handleHint: Without @; use the person’s ANTSIA handle.
team.existingGrantHint: Browse the team to review the existing permission before inviting this person again.
team.reinviteConfirm: Invite {{name}} again with this reviewed permission?

status.unavailable: This newsroom or action is not available at the moment.
status.offline: You are offline. Your fields are kept; reconnect and review the information before continuing.
status.reviewRequired: Review the current state before continuing.
status.newer: A newer version is available. Your input is kept.
status.reloadConfirm: Replace your input with the currently saved version?
status.noPermission: Your permission does not allow this action.
status.noMedia: No newsroom configured for this page.

validation.length: This text exceeds the allowed length.
validation.limit: The maximum number of items has been reached.
validation.link: Enter a complete, permitted HTTPS address.
validation.sectionKey: Use a stable lower-case identifier without spaces.
validation.schedule: Choose a valid future local date and time.

errors.conflict: Another change has been saved. Your input is kept; review the current version before trying again.
errors.consent: Confirm the agreement with its current version.
errors.unavailable: This action is not available. Your fields are kept; review the information before trying again.

history.title: Version history
history.readOnly: These versions are read-only. They never automatically replace the draft or publication.
history.removed: This version was removed by moderation.

directory.title: Press
directory.lead: Find the network’s media outlets and their published articles.
directory.error: Media outlets are unavailable right now.
directory.empty: There are no accessible media outlets to show here.
directory.filteredWindow: No media outlet is visible in this window. You can continue to the next one.
